answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust edge, while reputation decays exponentially, halving its contribution at every temporal half-life. EigenTrust normalization propagates credibility through established peers; a freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality, and a collusive echo cannot bootstrap it without sustained honest service. Thus even a zenith or sable alias remains below consensus thresholds until independently trusted.
